verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser provides cloud browser sessions, AI-driven agent tasks, and an MCP server for on-demand automation, but nothing in the evidence describes defining trigger-condition rules (e.g. webhooks, scheduled/event-based watchers) that automatically fire actions on events — all examples are synchronous, user-initiated API calls or agent tasks. Missing for 10: any documented event-trigger/rule engine, webhook subscriptions, or scheduled/conditional automation feature.
